acceptance_predicates.description: The TUI qualification delegates plan creation, local mock run, recording, strict replay, comparison, and negative identity checks to the checked-in ASB-owned runner rather than reconstructing those artifacts locally.
The consumer accepts only a qualified, credential-free, network-denied receipt whose ASB and TUI source identities match the exact paired invocation.
After the ASB-owned qualification succeeds, the closed TUI journey probe succeeds without provider traffic or secret output.
The signed and DCO-certified exact head receives independent review, required hosted checks, merge, and exact-main post-merge verification.

definition_of_done: An exact ASB/TUI paired qualification passes with content-addressed selection identity, local mock execution, recording, strict replay, comparison, and negative identity coverage.
The merged TUI main has independent review and green repository-quality and trusted-main verification.

inputs.description: ASB AR-1686 authoritative runner and its qualified exact-pair receipt schema.
asb-tui content-addressed qualification wrapper and closed journey fixture.

outputs.description: Privacy-safe receipt binding exact ASB/TUI heads, denied network, absent credentials, and qualified runner output.
Reviewed and hosted-qualified TUI main merge.

gates.description: An exact paired ASB/TUI invocation produces a qualified, credential-free, network-denied receipt and the TUI journey probe succeeds.
Independent review, required PR checks, and both required exact-main post-merge workflows succeed.
